Placeholder panel

bb_placeholder.Rd

A patterned panel (diagonal stripes by default) with a centred sentence, for content a data source doesn't provide. Flexible by default, so it takes the height of its siblings in [bb_cols()].

Usage

bb_placeholder(
  text,
  fill = stripe_fill(),
  height = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  label_fill = "panel",
  label_width = 0.8,
  label_padding = unit(c(6, 10, 6, 10), "pt")
)

Arguments

text

Sentence shown on the panel.

fill

Panel fill: [stripe_fill()], a colour, or [gradient_fill()].

height

`grid::unit`, inches, or `NULL` for flexible.

style

Text style (or role name); default role `placeholder`.

label_fill

Fill behind the sentence (theme names allowed); `NA` for none.

label_width

Width of the sentence box as a fraction of the panel.

label_padding

Padding around the sentence.

Value

A block.

Examples

bb_placeholder("This country does not report subnational data.", height = 2)
#> <bb_placeholder>
